description: This source file implements the MixTaxonomyMappingReadPlatformService interface for the Fineract project. It provides functionality to retrieve taxonomy mapping data from a database using JDBC, with methods for mapping ResultSet rows to data objects and executing queries.

classes.name: MixTaxonomyMappingReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for reading taxonomy mappings, utilizing JDBC for database interactions.

classes.name: TaxonomyMappingMapper
classes.description: Inner class that maps a ResultSet row to a MixTaxonomyMappingData object.
